KOTESWAR
GEN-AI Engineer
Phone No: (571) 604-4560 Email: koteswargenai@gmail.com
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
● Gen-AI Engineer with 5+ years of experience in Python, ML/LLM engineering, and data engineering, specializing in
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), and multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph,
CrewAI) across AWS and Google Cloud.
● Hands-on experience with GPT-4, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, and BERT-family models using LangChain, Hugging Face
Transformers, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, Google Vector Search).
● Skilled in building and deploying MLOps pipelines (AWS SageMaker Pipelines, Step Functions, Docker) and production
REST APIs (Flask) for LLM-based applications.
● Experienced in prompt engineering (few-shot, zero-shot, chain-of-thought, retrieval-augmented prompting) and
cross-functional collaboration in Agile/Scrum teams.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Centific Corporation, Washington Jun 2025 – Present
Gen-AI Engineer / AI Engineer
Responsibilities:
● Developed MLOps pipelines on AWS using SageMaker Pipelines, Lambda, and Step Functions to orchestrate model
training, tuning, and deployment, reducing deployment time by 30%.
● Adapted existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to leverage Google Vertex AI and Google LLM APIs
for scalable LLM deployments.
● Designed hybrid search strategies combining vector similarity and keyword-based search using Google Vector Search,
improving document retrieval accuracy by 18%.
● Implemented Agent-to-Agent (A2A) workflows using LangGraph and CrewAI for task decomposition and delegation
across specialized LLM agents in a RAG pipeline, reducing task turnaround time by 25%.
● Deployed LLM-based workflows for call transcript summarization using GPT-4, LangChain, and vector databases (RAG
architecture), reducing manual review time by 45%.
● Fine-tuned domain-specific LLMs using LoRA/PEFT and benchmarked performance using accuracy, BLEU, perplexity,
and human feedback, achieving a 12% improvement in accuracy.
● Conducted A/B testing and evaluation of prompts using accuracy, coherence, and response-time metrics, improving
response coherence scores by 18%.
● Designed, implemented, and monitored ML solutions using CloudWatch and SageMaker Model Monitor, reducing
inference latency by 22%.
LevelUpNext, Ashburn, VA Jan 2024 – May 2025
Gen-AI Engineer

Responsibilities:
● Built advanced GenAI capabilities leveraging Hugging Face Transformers and LLaMA for multi-label classification on
architectural documentation, achieving 90% classification accuracy.
● Applied fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT) to improve model accuracy on specialized text datasets by 11%, and
implemented GraphRAG for structured output generation.
● Implemented RAG pipelines combining vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate) with optimized
prompts, reducing document search latency by 28%.
● Implemented Flask-based microservices deployed on Docker for scalable ML model inference.
● Developed monitoring dashboards using AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, and QuickSight, cutting incident
detection time by 32%.
Capgemini, Hyderabad, India Aug 2021 – Jun 2022
Sr. Python Developer
Responsibilities:
● Designed and developed RESTful APIs using Django to track events and enable analytical reporting for 10+ internal
stakeholders.
● Developed a Django-based web application with Python for data processing, MySQL for database management, and
interactive visualizations using HTML, CSS, jQuery, and Highcharts.
● Migrated Django databases from SQLite → MySQL → PostgreSQL, improving query performance by 22% and ensuring
complete data integrity.
● Developed full-stack modules with Django, building both frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, Bootstrap, AngularJS,
Node.js) and backend components.
● Applied Test-Driven Development (TDD) with Python's unit test framework, increasing test coverage to 85% and
reducing production defects.
● Used Git for version control and managed end-to-end deployments of Django applications.
Camp Systems Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad, India Nov 2020 – Jun 2021
Python Developer
Responsibilities:
● Implemented business logic using Django, Spring IOC, and Spring Security; developed controllers, views, and models.
● Developed entire frontend and backend modules using Python on the Django web framework.
● Built a test automation framework and Requirement Traceability Tool using Python and SeeTest APIs, cutting manual
QA effort by 28%.
● Coordinated with development teams on issue reproduction and resolution, and prepared risk mitigation plans,
improving release cycle time by 18%.
● Trained new joiners on test reporting, automation, and management best practices, onboarding 5 new engineers.
PROJECTS
RAG Document Q&A Application — Personal Project
● Built an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application for document question-answering using FAISS
for vector search, Ollama (LLaMA 3.2) for local LLM inference, and Streamlit for the interactive UI.
AI Chatbot with Tool Calling — Personal Project
● Developing a local AI chatbot in Python using Ollama (LLaMA 3.2) with function/tool calling and structured (Pydantic)
output for tasks such as real-time weather lookups.
● Built a FastAPI backend with a browser-based chat interface, evolving the project from a command-line tool into a full
web application.
EDUCATION
